text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper focuses on farmland protection zoning based on production potential using an agro-ecological zoning model coupled with spatial optimization; it does not conduct land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation as a primary focus. There is no spatial modeling of LULC change or prediction of future land cover/use patterns. The study is a spatial decision support tool for zoning farmland protection, assessing production potential and development potential under scenarios, but it does not produce mapped future LULC projections or involve LULC prediction modeling. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation.)
